description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nadukaradeniya, Kuruwita D/S Division, Rathnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extent of land, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land registration, property ownership, and title settlements, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
